newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ERPM says talks underway, urges caution.
newsitem.headline: ERPM says talks underway, urges caution.

text.p: East Rand Proprietary Mines Ltd on Thursday advised that negotiations were taking place which could have an effect on the share price of the company.
The company announced at its first quarter gold results presentation in April that the rationalisation of its interests on the East Rand (east of Johannesburg) was ongoing.

Mine managers Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd said last January that it had merged the management of ERPM and The Grootvlei Proprietary Mines Ltd as a precursor to the proposed rationalisation of its East Rand interests.
ERPM advised shareholders to exercise caution in share dealings until a further announcement was made.
